article.title: Microsoft Advertising十月更新：Conversions API正式開放，AI文案指引進入公開試行
article.title_en: Microsoft Advertising opens Conversions API and pilots AI copy guidelines
article.summary: Microsoft Advertising於10月28日公布十月更新：Conversions API已正式開放；AI文案messaging guidelines則向Performance Max及啟用AI Max的Search活動提供公開試行。
article.summary_en: Microsoft Advertising’s October 28 update makes Conversions API generally available, while messaging guidelines enter open pilot for Performance Max and Search campaigns with AI Max enabled.
article.why: 對依賴AI出價與跨渠道量度的團隊，轉換資料接入和文案控制值得一併檢視。伺服器傳送事件仍需確認同意管理、重複計算及資料欄位。
article.why_en: Teams relying on AI bidding can review conversion inputs alongside creative controls. Server-side events still require checks on consent, deduplication and data fields.
article.next_step: 先盤點UET與CRM事件，再評估CAPI接入；如參加文案試行，加入禁用聲稱並逐條檢查輸出。
article.next_step_en: Inventory UET and CRM events before evaluating CAPI. Pilot copy guidelines with prohibited claims and inspect generated output.
highlights: Conversions API以伺服器對伺服器方式接收網站、應用程式、CRM及POS轉換資料，並與UET並行。
文案指引最多可設40項，屬公開試行。
Performance Max年齡及性別定向已正式開放；裝置定向預計未來數週推出。
highlights_en: Conversions API accepts website, app, CRM and point-of-sale signals server to server, alongside UET.
Messaging guidelines allow up to 40 rules and remain in open pilot.
Performance Max age and gender targeting is generally available; device targeting rolls out over the coming weeks.
article.detail:
Microsoft Advertising於10月28日公布十月更新：Conversions API已正式開放；AI文案messaging guidelines則向Performance Max及啟用AI Max的Search活動提供公開試行。

Conversions API以伺服器對伺服器方式接收網站、應用程式、CRM及POS轉換資料，並與UET並行。

文案指引最多可設40項，屬公開試行。

Performance Max年齡及性別定向已正式開放；裝置定向預計未來數週推出。

對依賴AI出價與跨渠道量度的團隊，轉換資料接入和文案控制值得一併檢視。伺服器傳送事件仍需確認同意管理、重複計算及資料欄位。

先盤點UET與CRM事件，再評估CAPI接入；如參加文案試行，加入禁用聲稱並逐條檢查輸出。

各功能推出階段不同；公告中的優化效益屬平台說明，並非本刊獨立成效測試。
article.detail_en:
Microsoft Advertising’s October 28 update makes Conversions API generally available, while messaging guidelines enter open pilot for Performance Max and Search campaigns with AI Max enabled.

Conversions API accepts website, app, CRM and point-of-sale signals server to server, alongside UET.

Messaging guidelines allow up to 40 rules and remain in open pilot.

Performance Max age and gender targeting is generally available; device targeting rolls out over the coming weeks.

Teams relying on AI bidding can review conversion inputs alongside creative controls. Server-side events still require checks on consent, deduplication and data fields.

Inventory UET and CRM events before evaluating CAPI. Pilot copy guidelines with prohibited claims and inspect generated output.

Features have different rollout stages. Optimization benefits are Microsoft’s descriptions, not independent performance findings.
